name: Industry
overview: Scripture teaches that industry is a God-ordained responsibility, exemplified by God's placement of man in the garden to work and keep it, highlighting purposeful labor (Genesis 2:15). The command to labor six days and rest on the seventh underscores the balance between diligent work and God-ordained rest (Exodus 23:12; Exodus 35:2; Deuteronomy 5:13). Wisdom is drawn from observing the ant's diligent ways, encouraging believers to work with discipline and without needing constant oversight (Proverbs 6:6-7). These verses collectively affirm that productive labor is both a divine mandate and a wise practice for the believer.
